note: Not a repo conversion: the marketplace content is hand-maintained in place. No upstream clone, no builder regeneration - edit marketplace/plugins/1password-enconvo directly; Enconvo reads the folder marketplace where it stands.
marketplace_description: 1Password Environments for Enconvo: manage Environments, add variables, and mount on-demand .env files with secrets never returned to the agent — a curated native plugin over 1Password's official Environments MCP server. By Iteractive Development.

related.upstream_server: 1Password Environments MCP server (1password-mcp) - provisioned by the 1Password desktop app, not bundled; upstream security stays 1Password's
